Elena — thanks for the context and for filling out the CSV. We've put together two commercial options and a recommended technical runway:

Option A (12-month amendment):
- Add three additional app projects (dev/stage/prod keys each)
- Reserved capacity block for peak cycles (equivalent to +40% of current allocated throughput)
- Pricing uplift: +18% on current unit rates; one-time onboarding credit of $10k

Option B (24-month amendment):
- Same scope as A
- Pricing uplift: +12% on current unit rates (longer term discount)
- One-time onboarding credit of $20k and 60 days prioritized onboarding queue

We attached the Pricing_Amendment_2027-03-11.xlsx with line-item details and a redline to the SOW. Operational notes: Karthik confirmed we can issue keys programmatically and have ETA of 48 hours after kickoff for dev/stage keys, 5 business days for prod keys pending Org verification. Vanessa will send CS owners and a kickoff agenda once we lock the date.

Next steps:
1) Please confirm which amendment option you prefer (A or B) by Mar 22 so procurement can route the DocuSign. Link to draft DocuSign: https://www.docusign.com/agreements/abc123
2) Confirm kickoff Mar 16, 10:00 PT (we'll send invite)
3) Provide final project names in the API_Key_Request_Template.csv so Karthik can queue keys immediately after kickoff

I've copied procurement and our technical leads; happy to jump on a quick call if you'd like to walk the options.
